Suggested vendors

People to call for the things we don’t do.

There is no kitchen, no bar and no event staff in the Star View Room, so the food, the drink and the extras come from whoever you choose. These are local businesses we have talked to and are happy to point you toward.

They are suggestions, not requirements. Bring anyone you like. There is no catering minimum and no corkage.
